The name Amal burga can be interpreted as "work of the fortress," suggesting a strong spiritual foundation and protection from the worldly challenges. Amalburga was also associated with St. Amalburga, a 6th-century Irish saint who was revered for her academic abilities, piety, and charitable works. She was believed to have founded several monasteries and provided refuge to travelers and the needy. Thus, the name Amalburga symbolized not just physical strength and fortitude but also spiritual fortitude and the ability to provide spiritual guidance and support to those in need.
